answer: Require five jurors from five operators, claw back the reward the moment a replay is detected on any submitted task, and vest the rest against future work so payout arrives over 40 epochs instead of at once. Budget it in hours: an honest answer costs 30 minutes of work plus one epoch of waiting, while a comet of cloned submissions costs a bond plus a plume of hours already spent on the duplicate that got replayed. The glacier does not care about urgency.
